text: APPROVE. Pulling the closure and the nested ternaries/`if` out of the loop should drop `BuildPlan` well under 15 (by my estimate, 25 to about 11), and behaviour is unchanged: the per-iteration `method` capture is equivalent to the old `var m = method`, `continue` becomes an early `return` at the end of the loop body, and the delegate types still match the original lambdas. I judged this from the diff alone and did not build it, so the build is the one thing I haven't confirmed. It looks fine because `System.Reflection` is almost certainly already imported, given the file already calls `GetParameters()` and `IsStatic`.
